description: This file defines functions and types for setting up secret references in a provider authentication context, including prompting the user for input and resolving secret references.

methods.name: formatErrorMessage
methods.description: Formats an unknown error into a string message.

methods.name: extractEnvVarFromSourceLabel
methods.description: Extracts environment variable name from a source label string.

methods.name: resolveDefaultProviderEnvVar
methods.description: Resolves the default environment variable for a given provider.

methods.name: resolveDefaultFilePointerId
methods.description: Generates default file pointer ID for a provider.

methods.name: resolveRefFallbackInput
methods.description: Resolves a secret reference fallback input based on config and environment.

methods.name: promptEnvSecretRefForSetup
methods.description: Prompts user to input environment variable secret reference.

methods.name: promptProviderSecretRefForSetup
methods.description: Prompts user to input provider secret reference and validates it.

methods.name: promptSecretRefForSetup
methods.description: Main function to prompt user for secret reference setup, choosing between env and provider.
